# Kutjevo Biolab (LV-686)
[italic]Date 2181 - Kutjevo Biolab. A level three biohazard containment and research facility operated by the Weyland-Yutani Corporation.[/italic]
[bold]Kutjevo[/bold] is a boom-or-bust colony on the desert world LV-686, just outside the American Corridor. Best known as a [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] water bottling plant, it is now home to a W-Y biohazard containment and research facility.
## History - Discovered in 2089, LV-686 wasn't settled until 2158, and declared itself aligned with the independents in 2160. - Kutjevo was founded that year as an independent offshoot of a core world colony. The planet was expected to be a desert needing terraforming, but turned out to have a thriving ecosystem fed by underground aquifers of drinkable water. - In 2162 a hostile takeover by members of the Canadian Space Affairs Ministry seized the colony's administration, and it was sold to Weyland-Yutani that December. - Bottling for the Company's [bold]Weyland Spring[/bold] brand began in 2165. Jobs drew in colonists from across the outer American Corridor, and the refinery and colony boomed.
## The Colony - Over 2,000 colonists live at Kutjevo, around 70% of them employed by the Company and the rest in supporting work. - It is a prime candidate to be formally recognized within the [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"]' sphere of influence. - The colony's original central aquifers have long since run dry, and only its outer sections still pump and filter water.
## LV-686 LV-686 orbits a white subgiant star, 25 times brighter than the Sun, with a small red dwarf companion. Its gravity is almost exactly Earth's. Of its three moons, the smallest is known as [bold]"The Chariot"[/bold] for its strangely fast orbit, circling the planet in just a week and a half.
